reason: This is a cross-cutting refactor of the core `sessionctx.Context` contract into planner/expression-facing contexts, touching central interfaces in `pkg/sessionctx`, `pkg/planner`, `pkg/expression`, `pkg/session`, and `pkg/table`. Even if intended as dependency cleanup, interface reshaping at this layer can easily hide high-severity regressions in planning/runtime context propagation, session behavior, infoschema/table access, and expression evaluation assumptions.
